name: JPK EVO
tagline: High-Speed Scanning Digital Textile and Paper Printer

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial textile printing technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure superior color accuracy, and support diverse fabric applications.

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to support multiple ink technologies, offering flexibility for various fabric types while maintaining exceptional print quality and durability.

inkTypes.name: Reactive
inkTypes.fabrics: Cotton · Linen · Viscose · Natural Cellulose Fibres

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Variable Drop Technology with 16 Gray Levels
items.desc: Industrial printheads with 4 to 72 picolitre variable drop range and 16 gray levels produce smooth tonal transitions, crisp fine detail, and accurate solid fills in a single print pass.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Dual laser-beam sensors continuously scan for fabric unevenness ahead of the carriage and automatically halt movement before contact, protecting printheads from damage at all operating speeds.

items.title: Inline Ink Degasser
items.desc: Real-time air bubble removal from the ink circuit prevents nozzle inconsistencies and maintains top print quality throughout long high-speed production runs.

items.title: Uninterrupted Ink Supply System
items.desc: Ink tanks can be refilled during active printing without stopping the machine, eliminating production interruptions on high-coverage or extended-run jobs.

items.title: Integrated Belt Washing System
items.desc: Automated belt cleaning reduces manual maintenance time, extends belt service life, and keeps the conveying surface free from ink buildup across continuous production shifts.

items.title: Auto Cleaning System
items.desc: Automated wiper and capping assembly maintains printhead nozzle condition between jobs and enables immediate, clean restart after any period of inactivity.

items.title: Wi-Fi Remote Control and Embedded Web Server
items.desc: Wireless monitoring and real-time production cost reporting are accessible from any connected device, giving operators and managers full visibility without being stationed at the machine.

items.title: ACIMIT Green Label Certified
items.desc: Independently certified for reduced energy, water, and chemical consumption, supporting manufacturers with sustainability commitments and international buyer compliance requirements.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Wide-Format Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Scanning output across print widths from 1800 mm to 3200 mm makes the JPK EVO ideal for wide-format polyester and blended fabric printing for fashion wholesale and export markets.

fabrics.title: Large Home Textile and Furnishing Production
fabrics.desc: Wide print width capability suits large-format bedding, curtain fabric, upholstery, and furnishing textile production where standard 1800 mm machines create unnecessary seam constraints.

fabrics.title: Transfer Paper Printing
fabrics.desc: Dual media compatibility enables efficient sublimation transfer paper printing alongside direct fabric output, giving businesses the flexibility to serve both production workflows.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Performance Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: High-speed disperse and pigment printing on stretch and technical fabrics for sportswear brands, gym wear manufacturers, and performance apparel exporters.

fabrics.title: Sustainable and Export-Focused Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: ACIMIT Green Label certification demonstrates documented resource efficiency for manufacturers serving European and international buyers with environmental compliance requirements.

fabrics.title: Flag, Banner, and Soft Signage Production
fabrics.desc: Extra-wide format capability up to 3200 mm makes the JPK EVO well suited to soft signage, flags, banners, and exhibition textile applications alongside standard fabric production.

fabrics.title: Long-Run Industrial Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Inline degassing, live ink refill, and integrated belt washing combine to make the JPK EVO a reliable workhorse for manufacturers running continuous multi-shift production schedules.
